objectives.statement: Recognize that Norwegian often leaves the preposition after the verb phrase in questions and relative clauses.
Choose natural word order for questions such as hvem ... med and hva ... på.
Use stranded prepositions in relative clauses with som and det.
Identify and fix forced English-style preposition placement in ordinary Bokmål sentences.

notes: Must teach Norwegian preposition stranding in questions and relative clauses. Include natural Bokmål patterns and avoid forced English-style pied-piping.
